question: What protective power does the thirty-four-syllable Tārā extend to the whole body?
premises: Tārā is described as consisting of thirty-four syllables
A plea for protection is addressed to Tārā
The entire body is the object of protection
inference: The thirty-four-syllable form of Tārā is invoked to protect the entire body.
plain_english: May Tārā, composed of thirty-four syllables, protect the entire body.
